rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES FROM COMPULSORY COVERAGE IN THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 3 AND 24 OF THE 'REVISED GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE ACT OF 1977'
rows.abstract: Exempts the members of the AFP from the mandatory membership and compulsory insurance coverage with the GSIS by amending PD 1146, otherwise known as the "Revised Government Service Insurance Act." States that the premiums for Employees CompensationInsurance, extra hazard and health (medicare) of military personnel of the AFP as appropriated and as previously computed by the GSIS-DBM Reconciliation Task Force shall be released to the AFP RSBS.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING KINDERGARTEN CLASS IN THE PRIMARY EDUCATION IN ALL PUBLIC SCHOOLS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Is premised on the observation that preparatory education such as kindergarten has been proven to be an effective foundation which develops the academic interest of a child and unfortunately, not all children can avail of a preparatory education because of exorbitant being charged by private institutions offering such education.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Requires all Filipino citizens with at least seventeen years of age to apply for registration and for the issuance of an identification card with a permanent serial number. at the office of the local civil registrar of the locality where he resides.Directs the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to establish a system for the implementation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-26
